title: Smart Data Models - DigitalAsset
description: A concrete digital asset (web site, mobile app, social media profile, search engine listing, paid-ads account, etc.) that belongs to a Brand and is observed through a specific SoftwareApplication (e.g. Google Analytics 4, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Business). One Brand can group N DigitalAssets.

id.description: Unique identifier of the entity. Recommended pattern: urn:ngsi-ld:DigitalAsset:<Brand>-<Software>[-<suffix>]. Suffix is only needed if the same Brand has multiple channels on the same SoftwareApplication.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be DigitalAsset.

name.description: Property. Human-readable name of the channel (e.g. 'Acme Web GA4', 'Acme LinkedIn Page').

description.description: Property. Free-text description of the channel.

digitalAssetUrl.description: Property. Canonical URL of the channel itself: the page being measured for a Web channel, the LinkedIn organization URL for a social profile, the app store URL for a mobile app, etc. Differs from Brand.url which is the brand landing.

digitalAssetKind.description: Property. High-level kind of the digital channel. Optional: helps consumers filter without having to introspect SoftwareApplication. Extend the enum if a new kind is needed; treat 'Other' as a temporary catch-all and request a proper value via PR.

externalId.description: Property. Native identifier of the channel inside its SoftwareApplication. Examples: GA4 property id ('properties/123456789'), LinkedIn organization id, Meta business id. Optional but recommended for traceability and joins back to source systems.

refBrand.description: Relationship. URN of the Brand that owns this channel.

refSoftwareApplication.description: Relationship. URN of the SoftwareApplication used to measure or operate this channel (e.g. urn:ngsi-ld:SoftwareApplication:GoogleAnalytics4).
